listing.title: Deck the Shelves Shirt, Bookish Christmas Tee, Book Christmas Tree Shirt, Book Lover Gift, Black Cat Book Shirt, Librarian Gift
listing.description: A Christmas tree built from stacked books, painted book by book in watercolor: deep red, forest green, navy, gold and plum spines with gold bands and labels, a few turned to show their cream page edges, a string of colorful lights wound round it and a glowing gold star on top. Wrapped presents, a pine garland with pinecones and little glass baubles sit at its foot, and a black cat in a red striped scarf keeps watch, all in a warm golden glow. "Deck the" in burgundy script, "SHELVES" in green serif capitals and "bookish & bright" in gold script. For the reader, librarian or book-club friend who would rather decorate a shelf than a tree.
